category_title: Student with Down Syndrome exhibiting constant disruptive verbalizations
minimal_context: The student is working individually on a modified reading worksheet during morning reading instruction in the general education classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for morning reading. Here is your modified reading worksheet.

STUDENT: (Makes a loud vocalization while looking at the ability-level materials.)

TUTOR: Let's try to read the first word on the page.

STUDENT: (Continues making loud noises instead of looking at the reading passage.)

TUTOR: Keep trying to focus on your paper.

STUDENT: (Produces constant noises and verbalizations loud enough to attract the attention of the other students working at the reading table across the room.)

options.A: Provide instruction in math, reading, and science using a modified curriculum.
options.B: Provide a clear beginning and end for each reading task on the worksheet.
options.C: Create a reading community founded on respect for choice and individual perspectives.
options.D: Use a digital app to take notes, organize worksheets, and archive past passages.
